value: Changes that fix a misprice, read the game as shown, or hold across unvaried content pass on level-or-better: paired end HP - 2 se >= -1 HP, paired clears >= -0.02, no goal-1 row <= -1 HP and > 2 se below 0. A protocol fail alone doesn't close one.

history.value: A change that fixes a misprice, reads the game as it shows itself, or holds across content today's fights don't vary passes on a level-or-better read, not the protocol's +1.5 HP (owner, docs/direction.md 'Level and more general is a pass'): paired end HP minus 2 se not below -1 HP and paired clears (point estimate) not below -0.02 against the control, and no goal-1 row worse, a row failing when its paired difference is -1 HP or worse and more than 2 se below zero. A protocol fail alone does not close such a change.
